description: Royal Jordanian Air Force F-16A Air Defense Fighter preserved at Muwaffaq Salti air base, Azraq. Construction number 61-353. Spottingmode records that it wears the serial 2297 while carrying the airframe as 229; the marking and the identity therefore differ. Record dates to September 2018.

Two-seat F-104B preserved as a gate guard at Muwaffaq Salti air base, Azraq, at what the International F-104 Society describes as the entrance to the Netherlands air force deployment camp on the base. Ex USAF 57-1294, coded A. Spottingmode carries the location without a linked airframe; the identity comes from the F-104 society alone.
